answer_1.quote: We aggregate 9 existing annotated factuality datasets to create our benchmark AGGREFACT ... All datasets contain summaries generated from articles in CNN/DM and XSum.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries evaluated for factual consistency

answer_2.quote: We evaluate several SOTA factual consistency metrics on our benchmark, namely DAE, QuestEval, SummaC‑ZS, SummaC‑Conv and QAFactEval ... We also benchmark recent ChatGPT‑based evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: ChatGPT‑ZS and ChatGPT‑CoT prompt LLMs to directly output a binary factuality decision.

answer_4.quote: We aggregate 9 existing annotated factuality datasets ... annotators: 3 crowd‑sourced annotators ... We manually corrected the labels for these examples based on our judgment.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each summary as consistent or inconsistent and annotate error types (intrinsic/extrinsic, noun phrase/predicate).
criteria: error type (intrinsic, extrinsic, noun phrase, predicate)
